name: veyra
description: Veyra is a free and open-source platform for discovering, testing, and distributing open-source Discord bots through an official Discord server and website

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/discordBot --noEmit && tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p tests --noEmit && tsc -p apps/site --noEmit
scripts.docker:recreate: docker compose down && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
scripts.clear:win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Get-ChildItem -Path . -Directory -Recurse -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('node_modules','dist','logs') } | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.clear: bash -c "find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name dist -o -name logs \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true"
scripts.clear:mac: find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name dist -o -name logs \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true

author: P4ciuf
